question: I’m a huge huge huge fan of Ace. If he didn’t die during the Summit War, what kind of face would he have? Please draw him at age 40 and age 60, Oda Eiichiro-sama~!! of Ace of the Whitebeard Crew.
answer: Got it. Top row: * Age 40: Yo Luffy, still the same as always. * Age 60: I’m retired. Bottom row (a future if something happened/went wrong): * Age 40: Osu Luffy, lend me some money. * Age 60: Chopper, just a little bit from the safe… Hard to say what would have happened over the course of his life, but I drew these two patterns (possibilities).
name: Daughter of Ace of the Whitebeard Crew
